description: Occasions (birthday, Christmas, Sinterklaas, new sibling, bedtime story...) with ready-made storylines for a personalised children's book, in the user's language. The stories suit children of about 2 to 8. Do not ask for the child's age, name or photo: just ask which story they like.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the user writes in, e.g. 'en', 'nl', 'de'
